request.title: Refute Printed.wirtinger_exponentialDecay (Ch05 Sec3b_Printed, Proposition 5.3.3.2(2)(2), p. 250)
request.body:
Closes #4813

**Proved** (refutation): `Printed.wirtinger_exponentialDecay_false` in `RiemannMasullo/Ch05_ThetaZSpaces/Sec3b_Printed.lean` (Proposition 5.3.3.2(2)(2), p. 250; ERRATA F53).

The counterexample differs slightly from the docstring's, to use only what is on `main`: m = 0, a = −1, and h(z) = |z|² exp(−|z|²), i.e. the restriction of the Gaussian (`complexSchwartz_restrict_positiveDecay`) multiplied by the modulation |z|². Each twist of h with exponent b > −1 is the twist of the Gaussian with exponent b + 1 > 0, so h lies in the source space. At a real point t > 0 the holomorphic Wirtinger derivative of its zero extension is t(1 − t²)exp(−t²) (computed from `hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq`), so the target twist with exponent −3/4 has modulus t^(−1/2)(1 − t²)exp(−t²), unbounded as t → 0. Schwartz–Bruhat functions on ℂˣ are bounded (from `mem_schwartzBruhatSubmodule_iff` and the zeroth elementary Schwartz bound), a contradiction. A sentence describing this is added to the docstring of the refutation.

Private helpers, directly above the theorem: `Printed.wirtinger_exponentialDecay_bounded`, `Printed.wirtinger_exponentialDecay_deriv`, `Printed.wirtinger_exponentialDecay_point`. Added import: `RiemannMasullo.ForMathlib.Analysis.Distribution.SchwartzSpace.Gaussian` (for `SchwartzMap.gaussian`).

`#print axioms RiemannMasullo.Printed.wirtinger_exponentialDecay_false`: `propext`, `sorryAx`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. The `sorryAx` comes from `complexSchwartz_restrict_positiveDecay` (Ch05 Sec3b, still open upstream), which the proof uses to put the Gaussian in the source space.

Checks run: `lake build` (full, passes, 18 min), `scripts/lint.sh` (ok), `scripts/signatures.sh --compare` on the module's signatures before/after (via `scripts/Signatures.lean`; no changes). Module builds in about 8 s.

#4816 in the same file was claimed and released with a note (needs a Schwartz–Bruhat function on ℚ₃ˣ that is not compactly supported at zero, and local constancy of S-adelic tests in the finite coordinate).
